title: Modify append_to_groups to return article number assignments
description:
What: append_to_groups() in crates/reader/src/post/log_append.rs currently returns Result<(), Response>. Change it to return Result<Vec<(String, u64)>, Response> where each tuple is (group_name, article_number) for each group the article was appended to.
Algorithm:
1. In crates/reader/src/post/log_append.rs:
   a. Change return type to Result<Vec<(String, u64)>, Response>
   b. After calling article_numbers.assign_number(group, cid) for each group, collect (group.to_string(), number) into a Vec
   c. Return Ok(assignments) on success
2. Update all callers: in lifecycle.rs, change:
   if let Err(resp) = append_to_groups(...).await { return resp; }
   to:
   let assignments = match append_to_groups(...).await { Ok(a) => a, Err(e) => return e };
3. Run cargo build to find all remaining call sites and fix them
4. Add test: append to 2 groups returns 2 assignments with correct group names
Defensive: if assign_number fails for one group, still try remaining groups; collect failures but return error if any fail.
Acceptance: test_append_returns_assignments passes; cargo test -p usenet-ipfs-reader clean.
